title: Do Large Language Models Play Six Degrees of Separation? Measuring Topological Compression in Long-Context Manifolds
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multi-hop reasoning capabilities over long contexts, yet the internal mechanisms enabling these distant cognitive leaps remain poorly understood. Traditional attention-based interpretability often fails to capture true semantic proximity due to routing artifacts like attention sinks.
